name: equality
query: select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: reversed equality
query: select * from engagements where {account_external_id} = org_id

name: scoped conjunction
query: select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id} and (active or recent)

name: scoped disjunction
query: select * from engagements where (org_id = {account_external_id} and active) or (org_id = {account_external_id} and recent)

name: scoped union
query: select * from first_table where org_id = {account_external_id} union all select * from second_table where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: scoped subquery
query: select * from (select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}) e where e.org_id = {account_external_id}

name: scoped aggregation
query: select count() from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: no filter
query: select * from engagements

name: select placeholder
query: select {account_external_id}, * from engagements

name: comment placeholder
query: select * from engagements -- {account_external_id}

name: string placeholder
query: select * from engagements where name = '{account_external_id}'

name: unscoped disjunction
query: select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id} or true

name: not equal
query: select * from engagements where org_id != {account_external_id}

name: negated filter
query: select * from engagements where not (org_id = {account_external_id})

name: constant comparison
query: select * from engagements where {account_external_id} = {account_external_id}

name: select alias
query: select {account_external_id} as org_id, * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: with alias
query: with {account_external_id} as org_id select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: where alias
query: select * from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id} and ({account_external_id} as org_id)

name: unscoped union branch
query: select * from first_table where org_id = {account_external_id} union all select * from second_table

name: unscoped subquery
query: select (select count() from other_table) from engagements where org_id = {account_external_id}

name: unscoped cte
query: with other as (select * from other_table) select * from other where org_id = {account_external_id}
